scope.description: Whole openscad application/library breadth across useful functional families.
scope.denominator: Scripted constructive geometry, 2D profiles/extrusion, transformations, parameterisation, imports and mesh publication.

coverage.rationale: Two fabrication part families are useful but do not expose general constructive geometry or the modelling language.

scope.description: Dimensioned mounting plates with hole patterns and annular spacers to editable source and checked faceted solids.
scope.denominator: User intent and domain decisions within the named supported workflows, including declared inputs, composition and useful outputs; excluded application features do not enter this score.

abstraction.rationale: Fabrication dimensions, clearances and hole-pattern intent replace CSG scripts and topology plumbing within these part families.

limitations: Bounded plate/spacer geometry and translations only; faceted surfaces, constrained hole separation and tessellation; no authored OpenSCAD language.

Editorial estimate from current contracts, guidance and completion evidence; no exhaustive native API denominator or new native acceptance was measured for this assessment. Qualification and runtime availability must be queried separately.
